LightningComponentBundle.description: Generic server-side datatable: paging, sorting, filtering, search, inline edit, bulk save/delete and partial-error reporting for any object.

property.name: enableConflictDetection
property.label: Detect Edit Conflicts
property.description: Reject an inline edit if someone else changed the record after it was loaded.

property.name: enableColumnChooser
property.label: Enable Column Chooser
property.description: Let users hide and show columns.

property.name: viewKey
property.label: Saved Views Key
property.description: Set a key that is unique to this table (e.g. accounts-main) to turn on per-user saved views. Leave blank to turn them off.

property.name: autoRefresh
property.label: Refresh When Records Change
property.description: Reload when records of this object change. Requires Change Data Capture to be enabled for the object in Setup.
